name: EuroSAT RGB classroom subset
layout: HWC / row-major RGB uint8. Browser maps v to v/127.5 - 1.
license: MIT (EuroSAT repository); Copernicus Sentinel data terms also apply
attribution: EuroSAT: Patrick Helber, Benjamin Bischke, Andreas Dengel, Damian Borth. Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data; RGB image chips resized for this educational demonstration.
citation: Helber et al. (2019), EuroSAT: A Novel Dataset and Deep Learning Benchmark for Land Use and Land Cover Classification. DOI: 10.1109/JSTARS.2019.2918242
split_method: Deterministic class-stratified image-level subset: seed 7711810 + class index. Per class 60 train, 20 development, 20 final. Unique original file IDs, no derivative image crosses splits.
limitations: Educational subset of 300 images and 3 of 10 classes; not the full benchmark.
Image-level split only: geographic independence and overlap between neighbouring scenes have not been established; no claim of new-region generalisation.
64x64 RGB chips downsampled to 24x24; not live satellite data or a physical contiguous map.
A gallery mosaic of chips is a classification summary, not a georeferenced land-cover map.
Development images can be used for inspection and changes; keep final images out of training/augmentation and do not use final scores to repeatedly select models.
